# Code of conduct / 行为准则

This project follows the [Contributor Covenant 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/). In short:

- Be respectful and assume good intent. Critique code and ideas, not people.
- No harassment, insults, discrimination, sexual language or imagery, or personal attacks, in public or in private.
- Do not publish other people's private information (names behind accounts, addresses, account numbers, API keys).
- No advertising or self-promotion in issues and discussions.

It applies in issues, pull requests, discussions and any other space of the project, and when you represent the project elsewhere.

**Reporting.** Tell the maintainers privately: open the repository's Security tab and choose "Report a vulnerability" (only maintainers can read it; start the title with "Conduct"), or use GitHub's "Report content" on the comment or issue. Reports are handled confidentially. Maintainers may edit or remove content, and warn, suspend or ban anyone who breaks these rules.

本项目遵循 [Contributor Covenant 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/zh-cn/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/)。简单说：

- 互相尊重，先假定对方是善意的。讨论代码和想法，不针对人。
- 不骚扰、不辱骂、不歧视，不发表性暗示的言语或图片，不做人身攻击，公开和私下都一样。
- 不公开别人的隐私信息（账号背后的真名、住址、账户号、API key）。
- 不在 issue 和讨论区打广告或自我推销。

这些规则适用于 issue、PR、讨论区和项目的其他所有地方，也适用于你在别处代表本项目的时候。

**举报。** 请私下告诉维护者：打开仓库的 Security 标签页，选择「Report a vulnerability」（只有维护者能看到，标题请以 "Conduct" 开头），或者在相关评论、issue 上使用 GitHub 的「Report content」。举报会保密处理。维护者可以修改或删除相关内容，并对违反规则的人给予警告、暂停或禁止参与。
